title: Lamb Koftas with Flatbread
description: Tender lamb koftas served with crispy flatbread and a side of spicy sauce. A classic Indian street food recipe.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine lamb, sesame seeds, yogurt, sumac, and a pinch of salt. Mix well with your hands until just combined.
Divide the mixture into 4-6 portions, depending on how large you want your koftas to be.
Shape each portion into a cylinder and place on a plate or tray.
Thread the koftas onto skewers, if using.
Grill the koftas for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until cooked through.
Meanwhile, toast the flatbread on the grill or in a toaster.
Serve the koftas hot with toasted flatbread and your favorite chutneys or raitas.
